description: This file contains implementation of functions related to EIC (Embedded Identity Credential) provisioning, including initialization, credential creation, personalization, access control profile management, and credential data encryption. It is part of a security/authentication module in an Android-based project.

methods.name: eicProvisioningInit
methods.description: Initializes the EicProvisioning context, setting it to zero and generating a random storage key.

methods.name: eicProvisioningInitForUpdate
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning context for an update, decrypting credential keys and setting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: eicProvisioningCreateCredentialKey
methods.description: Creates a credential key based on a challenge and application ID, if not in update mode.

methods.name: eicProvisioningStartPersonalization
methods.description: Begins the personalization process, setting up CBOR structures and digesters for credential provisioning.

methods.name: eicProvisioningAddAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile, computes its MAC, and appends it to the CBOR structure.

methods.name: eicProvisioningBeginAddEntry
methods.description: Starts adding an entry to the credential, setting up CBOR structures and tracking entry sizes.

methods.name: eicProvisioningAddEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an entry, encrypts it, and verifies integrity via SHA-256.

methods.name: eicProvisioningFinishAddingEntries
methods.description: Finalizes the entries, signs the CBOR structure, and outputs the signature.

methods.name: eicProvisioningFinishGetCredentialData
methods.description: Finalizes credential data, encrypts it, and outputs the encrypted credential keys.
